title: Single Molecule FISH Protocol
author: Thuc Nguyen
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bb4qiqvw
materials: Proceed to hybridization. See section above.

steps.title: Clean and Prepare Coverslips
steps.instruction: Clean Thorlabs #CG15KH coverslips and prepare them for silanization.

substeps.instruction: Clean coverslips with lens paper and 70% ethanol.
Load coverslips into a plasma cleaning oven using a quartz coverslip rack (or a clean glass container), touching only the edges with clean gloves.
Form vacuum in the oven and run plasma cleaning for 30 mins.
Pipette 100 μl of 3-aminopropyltriethoxysilane (APES, Sigma #A3648) onto a crumpled KimWipe and place it next to the coverslips during the plasma process.

steps.title: Silanize Coverslips
steps.instruction: Apply APES silanization to the coverslips in a vacuum desiccator.

substeps.instruction: Transfer coverslips to a vacuum desiccator.
Pipette 100 μl of 3-aminopropyltriethoxysilane (APES, Sigma #A3648) onto a crumpled KimWipe and place next to coverslips.
Form vacuum and let sit for 10 min.
Wash coverslips by moving them up and down 5 times in 100% methanol, then in fresh methanol to remove free silanes.
Allow coverslips to dry.

steps.title: Store or Mount Coverslips
steps.instruction: Store the prepared coverslips or adhere them to slides for sectioning.

substeps.instruction: To store: Keep in a cool, dry, low-dust place (stable for at least 2 months).
To mount: Place 10 μl of nuclease-free water onto a clean slide and place a silanized coverslip on top.

steps.title: Section Tissue
steps.instruction: Prepare and collect brain tissue sections using a cryostat.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate the frozen OCT block with embedded brain in a -20°C cryostat for 30 minutes.
Make 10-μm sections and pick them up on pre-chilled silanized coverslips.
Let sections dry in the cryostat chamber for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Fix and Permeabilize Tissue
steps.instruction: Fix the tissue and permeabilize using methanol.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 4% PFA in PBS (fresh) and 100% methanol (pre-chilled to -20°C).
Immerse coverslips (attached to slides) in a slide rack in pre-chilled 4% PFA in PBS for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Remove coverslips from slides and place into a coverslip rack.
Wash 3x for 5 mins each with 1X PBS (made with nuclease-free water).
Permeabilize with 100% methanol for 10 mins at -20°C.
Remove coverslips from methanol and let dry completely at room temperature.

steps.title: Store Fixed Sections
steps.instruction: Box and freeze the processed coverslips for later use.

substeps.instruction: Group 2-6 coverslips per box and place each box into a zip lock bag.
Seal tight and store at -80°C (stable for up to three weeks).
When ready to use, remove the box and use all coverslips; do not return opened bags/boxes to the freezer.

steps.title: Prepare Imaging Chambers
steps.instruction: Mount sections into SecureSeal chambers within a clean PCR hood (RNase-free area).

substeps.instruction: Remove coverslips from -80°C and place on a glass slide for support.
Trim SecureSeal chambers (Grace Bio-Labs #621502) to fit the ASI Imaging Chamber (or equivalent) and place around each section.
Cover samples with port seal stickers or a humidified chamber before transferring to 37°C oven, 4°C fridge, or microscope.

steps.title: Equilibrate and Detergent Wash
steps.instruction: Equilibrate tissue and remove lipids using SDS.

substeps.instruction: Slowly pipette 2X SSC into the chamber to push out air bubbles; let equilibrate for 1 min (approx. 100 μl volume).
Pipette 200 μl of 8% SDS (vacuum filtered) into the chamber and incubate for 10 mins at room temperature.
Hold the coverslip sideways over a beaker and pipette 500 μl of 2X SSC through the chamber. Repeat 4 more times (5 total) or until the output is no longer soapy.

steps.title: Hybridization
steps.instruction: Equilibrate tissue and hybridize with probes.

substeps.instruction: Prepare Hybridization Buffer (HB): 10% formamide in 2X SSC with tRNA, RVC, and BSA.
Equilibrate tissue by pipetting 100 μl of HB (without probes) into the chamber for 5 mins.
Dilute probes in HB to a final concentration of 2 ng/μl.
Pipette the probe mix into the chamber and seal ports with stickers.
Incubate for 2 hours at 37°C in a humidified chamber (e.g., pipette tip box with wet paper towels, lid, and Parafilm).

steps.title: Post-Hybridization Washes
steps.instruction: Wash away unbound probes and apply DAPI.

substeps.instruction: Wash with Probe Wash Buffer (20% formamide in 2X SSC) containing 5 μg/ml DAPI for 10 mins at 37°C by pushing 500 μl through the chamber over a beaker.
Wash with Probe Wash Buffer (without DAPI) 2 x 10 min at 37°C, pushing 500 μl through each time.
Wash with 2X SSC by pipetting 500 μl through the chamber twice.

steps.title: Imaging and Signal Amplification
steps.instruction: Apply enzymes for imaging or proceed to stringency washes.

substeps.instruction: Add enzymes to Imaging Buffer (stored at 4°C for one month) and use immediately; pipette into the SecureSeal chamber for imaging.
Alternatively, replace Imaging Buffer with 2X SSC (Optional stopping point: store at 4°C overnight).

steps.title: Stringency Washes
steps.instruction: Perform final stringency washes to refine signal.

substeps.instruction: Add 65% formamide in 2X SSC (vacuum or syringe filtered) to the chamber for 3x 10 mins at 37°C (or 30°C).
Wash with 2X SSC 3x 5 mins at room temperature by pipetting 500 μl through the chamber each time (Optional stopping point: store at 4°C overnight).
